title: Traffic Orchestration Journal (draft)
content:
Context: personal scratchpad for the next model/version traffic migration to the new quantized runtime.

High-level goal:
- Shift production traffic from model:v2 (fp16) -> model:v3-q8 with minimal user-facing regressions and within current latency SLO.
- Keep cost delta < 8% while validating quality on a live workload.

Success criteria (for this run):
- No >3% increase in 95th p50 token latency for critical API routes in any region for >10 min.
- Token-level cost within target (observed avg delta <= +8%).
- Sampling-based quality checks: top-3 generation BLEU-style proxy (internal eval) agrees within threshold on daily holdback set.
- No increase in error budget (5xx) across services; if error rate exceeds 0.5% for any 10-minute window, auto-dry-run/rollback.

Quick notes / hypotheses:
- q8 quantization will reduce GPU memory and may increase small-tail latency due to kernel differences on A100 vs H100.
- Early-stage traffic should focus on low-rate, high-observability slices (internal traffic + non-SAML users).
- Pin-by-user vs pin-by-route: prefer pin-by-route for initial test to reduce surface area.

Telemetry and signals to monitor (live dashboards + alerts):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 for token generation and initial response.
- Errors: 5xx, model-timeouts, retry counts.
- Quality: sample-match rate vs baseline (via sampler that logs to /eval/samples).
- Cost: tokens per second and GPU utilization per cluster.
- User impact guardrails: degraded sessions (UX fallback events), session restarts.

Pre-flight checklist (must pass before any shift):
- [ ] Canary unit tests green (infra + integration) — PR #2891 merged.
- [ ] Staging e2e pass for long context (<= 32k) latency profile.
- [ ] Synthetic load test: sustained qps at 1.2x expected peak for 15m with no tail amplification.
- [ ] Observability fast-path: dashboards for model v3-q8 created and pinned on Console.
- [ ] Alert thresholds configured and smoke-notifications added to #deploy-alerts.
- [ ] Eviction/fallback policy verified (config: rollout.fallback=compatible-v2).
- [ ] Owner on call during rollout: Evan (primary), Lena (backup).

Traffic shift plan (conservative, staged):
- Phase A (internal): 0.5% traffic to v3-q8, duration 60m. Owners: Evan.
  - Focus on internal token routing, include long-context samples.
  - Checks every 10m: p95 latency delta, error spikes.
  - If any critical alert -> immediate 100% shift back to v2 and investigation.

- Phase B (pilot cohort): 2% traffic, 60m hold. Owners: Lena.
  - Include only accounts in pilot cohort label. Pin-by-route: /chat/infer-route=pilot
  - Verify sampling quality metric (sample-match > 95% of baseline).

- Phase C (regional ramp): 10% -> 25% -> 50% in 30m increments, 30m hold each.
  - Start in us-west only. If metrics stable, mirror to eu-central after 1h.
  - Automation: rwdctl rollout set-traffic --model model:v3-q8 --percent X --region us-west

- Phase D (full exposure): 100% after 6h of stable metrics across regions.

Emergency stop conditions (auto/Manual rollback):
- Any p95 latency increase > 10% sustained 5m -> auto-throttle (50% rollback) and alert.
- Error rate > 0.5% (10m) -> full rollback.
- Quality sampling drop > 7% vs baseline on any hold period -> manual hold and deep-dive.

Rollback commands (quick):
- rwdctl rollout set-traffic --model model:v2 --percent 100 --reason "auto-rollback - latency"
- rwdctl rollout pause --id <rollout-id> --owner Evan
- If control-plane unreachable: proxy route update via nginx config flip — ssh to infra-runner and apply /ops/traffic-flip.sh

Pinning decisions and notes:
- For user-facing clients with persisted sessions, pin to model:v2 until session rotation; do not migrate active sessions.
- Route-level pinning (safer): only migrate /batch-embed and certain asymmetrical routes for cost testing.
- Add header X-RWD-Model-Version on responses for debug; TTL logs for 24h.

Observability queries (starter examples):
- latency p95: sum by(region) (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(model_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
- error rate: increase(sum(rate(model_errors_total[5m])) by (region), 0)
- sample-match: count(eval_samples{model="v3-q8",match="true"}) / count(eval_samples{model="v3-q8"})

Open questions / TODOs:
- Where to route low-confidence outputs? Add a flag to force deterministic fallback to v2 for >0.9 uncertainty? (investigate with model-research)
- Should we enable KV cache migration concurrently? risk: cache schema mismatch. Recommendation: no for this run.
- Post-shift, do we want a golden-set rolling evaluation vs offline dataset nightly? Yes — create recurring job.

Post-deploy checklist (if successful):
- [ ] Bump default model alias in config (after 24h stable) and communicate to SDK teams.
- [ ] Create change-log entry with observed metrics and estimated cost delta.
- [ ] Schedule a 1-week follow-up retro for quality regressions and perf anomalies.

Notes to self (raw):
- Keep the pilot cohort small but diverse. Include accounts with long prompts (docs summarization), chat (short-turn), and embeddings.
- Talk to product-sre about fallback rate limits; avoid cascading retries to other clusters.
- Add a synthetic user that exercises edge tokenization cases (unicode, emojis) to spot subtle differences.

Vault keys and access: ensure runtime quantization profile config is uploaded to ssm:/prod/model-profiles/v3-q8 before Phase A.

Logs / artifacts to attach after run:
- samples.csv (5000 sampled pairs)
- perf-snapshots (p50/p95 timeline)
- deployment-plan.json (machine-readable for ops)

End of scratchpad. Will iterate after pre-flight results and first internal phase.

[signed-off-by] Evan P. — quick notes, not an official playbook.
